Precondition: User is not logged in and browser is at fresh state
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /installation-system
Expected Result: User is redirected to /login page with Sign in heading visible

Precondition: User is logged in as Engineering
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to /installation-system
2. Wait for page to load
Expected Result: URL is /installation-system. H3 "Filter functions" and "Select solutions you want to compare" are visible

Test Steps: 1. Observe filter chips below matching products count
Expected Result: Filter chips show: Region: NA, Element types: none selected, Max thread: Any, Force: Any, Compare selected: 0

Test Steps:
1. Click "PEM" button under Fastener element type(s)
2. Observe filter chips and matching count
Expected Result: PEM button becomes active/highlighted. Matching product count updates. Filter chip shows "Element types: PEM"

Test Steps:
1. Click "PEM" button
2. Click "SHEREX" button
3. Observe matching count
Expected Result: Both PEM and SHEREX are active. Count reflects combined results. Chips show both types

Test Steps: 1. Check "Process monitoring required" checkbox
Expected Result: Checkbox is checked. Matching product count filters to only machines with process monitoring feature

Test Steps: 1. Check "Robot integration required" checkbox
Expected Result: Checkbox is checked. Matching product count filters to only machines with robot integration capability

Test Steps: 1. Change Minimum (kN) input from 21 to 50
Expected Result: Force range updates. Matching product count changes. Force filter chip updates

Precondition: User has applied filters (element type + capability + force)
Test Steps: 1. Click "Reset filters" button
Expected Result: All filters return to defaults: no element selected, capabilities unchecked, force range 21-300. Count returns to original

Test Steps:
1. Check "A210" (Handtools - Pneumo Hydraulic)
2. Check "824 eDrive" (Standalone Machines - Servo-Electric)
3. Check "A240-CP" (Robotic Integration - Robotic Stations)
4. Check "MDS A100" (InDie)
5. Check "Full Custom Solution" (Custom)
Expected Result: All 5 checkboxes are checked. Filter chip shows "Compare selected: 5"

Test Steps: 1. Check any 3 solutions from different categories
Expected Result: Filter chip shows "Compare selected: 3". Count matches number of checked boxes

Test Steps: 1. Uncheck the selected solution
Expected Result: Compare selected count returns to 0. Comparison list shows empty state again

Precondition: User is on installation-system page with no solutions selected
Test Steps: 1. Scroll to Comparison list section
Expected Result: Empty state message displayed: "No solutions selected yet. Check solutions above to compare them here."

Test Steps: 1. Click "Setup New Application" button under Option B
Expected Result: Modal or form opens for creating a new application. Alternatively if no modal, verify button is clickable and navigates

Test Steps: 1. Click "Use Existing Application" button under Option B
Expected Result: Existing application selection UI appears. Verify button is clickable

Test Steps:
1. Scroll to "Enter your application parameters" section
2. Click "Add new application" button
Expected Result: New application form/modal opens for defining part and fastener parameters

Test Steps: 1. Scroll to Portfolio totals in application parameters section
Expected Result: All KPI values show "—": Total annual volume, Total fasteners/year, Fasteners/part, Element types/part, Parts/year

Precondition: Each role-based user is logged in
Test Steps:
1. For each role: navigate to /installation-system
2. Verify page loads
Expected Result: All 4 roles can successfully access the page. URL is /installation-system. Solution grid is visible

Test Steps:
